author: joebobthe2
body: Hi, my name is Joebobthe2 and i have been banned for 7 months now for Hacking-Fly which i was wrongly accused of, my laptop is fairly old and not the greatest and i was probably lagging at the time, i think that this server is really cool and unique and would really love the chance to be able to get back on it, i hope this gets out to someone who can help and thanks for reading.
